title: Is the deceased other parent alive?
question: Is {deceasedName}’s other parent alive?
paragraph1: This does not include any step-parents or any other parental figures who did not have parental responsibility for {deceasedName}.
paragraph2: Select ‘No’ if {deceasedName} did not have another parent.

anyOtherParentAlive.required: Select ‘Yes’ if {deceasedName}’s other parent is alive
